title: rigel2d-puppet 1.1 — rigel2d.json
description: The manifest entry of a .rigel2d archive: the format name and version, and nothing a reader needs to interpret. It exists so that deciding whether to refuse a file costs one small bounded read, before any load limit is at risk and before the structure is parsed.

major.description: A major that differs from the reading build's is a declared break: the file is refused whole and never opened partially.

minor.description: A minor higher than the reading build's opens, warns and stays editable, with everything unrecognised preserved. This schema describes 1.1; a file declaring a higher minor is outside what it can judge.
